notes.title: Fixed initial tutorial script
notes.content: Whoops! The last update broke the tutorial level, this one fixes it again.

notes.title: Added a homing missile / torpedo weapon
notes.content:
The big change here is a new "homing missile" weapon prototype - I haven't created the actual launcher model and animated yet, but I wanted to get other aspects of the experience working first.

The behavior is very different than the "plasma bolt" - you can dead-fire your missiles or achieve a lock on your target and fire. Enemies now also have these weapons and can use them against you.

I've also updated the cockpit - moved the shield/hull status displays to their own new areas and added a weapon display on the left & right sides of the cockpit. Eventually I'll show more useful information there, but for now it serves the purpose of letting you know which weapon is selected.

Another big improvement is upgrading to UE 5.3.2 which included a fix for meshes popping out of the right peripheral view.

notes.title: Weapon Swapping Improvements
notes.content:
This change switches the input for weapon swaps to pressing the right stick. This should avoid having the weapons swap when you're trying to move the ship vertically using the right stick.

I've also made a few other improvements around switching weapons - including audio feedback and a display on the ship that updates when the left vs. right weapon is selected (although this bit is a placeholder).

notes.title: Initial playtest update for 2023
notes.content:
The goal with this build is to check to start working on fixing issues (bugs, performance problems, etc.) with the idea that within a few months I might be able to offer a limited public playtest.

I appreciate any feedback (including that it just didn't work!)

Note that there are a few options under the graphics settings if performance isn't smooth enough.
